prompt: Compare firmware 2.1.0 with 2.0.4. What changed, and is 2.1.0 release-ready?

text: DHCP and IPv6 have no results on 2.1.0 yet, and both areas changed in this release: mesh-agent now starts at boot, and odhcpd was updated with new defaults [[ev:TB-01/doc/docs/firmware/2.1.0.md#changes]]. I'll run those two tests first, then compare everything against the 2.0.4 baseline.

args.title: Changed components · fw 2.1.0
args.rationale: Cover the components changed in 2.1.0 before comparing with 2.0.4.

items.rationale: mesh-agent now starts during boot, in front of dnsmasq; the lease time after boot may change.
odhcpd was updated in 2.1.0 with new ra_default and dns_service defaults.

text:
Both tests fail on 2.1.0 ({{report_id}}), and both are regressions against the 2.0.4 baseline.

| Area | 2.0.4 | 2.1.0 | Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| DHCP lease after boot | 1.48 s | 6.80 s | FAIL, regression |
| IPv6 RA router lifetime | 1800 s | 0 s | FAIL, regression |
| IPv6 RDNSS option | present | missing | FAIL, regression |
| Endurance 12 h | stable | OOM at 9 h 40 m | FAIL, regression (RPT-0009) |
| TCP throughput | ≈ 933 Mbps | 845.0 Mbps | lab issue, re-run needed |

- **The DHCP delay has the same root component as the OOM.** mesh-agent blocks for 5 s "waiting for backhaul scan" at boot [[ev:{{test_run:TC-DHCP-001}}/log/dut-syslog/41]] before giving up [[ev:{{test_run:TC-DHCP-001}}/log/dut-syslog/42]], so the client needs three DISCOVERs [[ev:{{test_run:TC-DHCP-001}}/pcap/capture-lan/7]] and the first ACK comes 6.80 s after LAN up [[ev:{{test_run:TC-DHCP-001}}/check/lease_time]]. One component, two symptoms.
- **The odhcpd update changed defaults:** router lifetime 0 [[ev:{{test_run:TC-IPV6-002}}/log/dut-syslog/52]] and no RDNSS [[ev:{{test_run:TC-IPV6-002}}/log/dut-syslog/53]], so IPv6 clients get no default route and no DNS server [[ev:{{test_run:TC-IPV6-002}}/pcap/capture-lan/2]].
- **Security finding:** the new telemetry service sends device data over plaintext HTTP to telemetry.vendor.example [[ev:{{test_run:TC-DHCP-001}}/pcap/capture-wan/69]]. It is the only new endpoint in the traffic profile and the only new plaintext one.

args.summary_md: 2.1.0 vs 2.0.4: regressions from mesh-agent (DHCP delay at boot; same component as the OOM in RPT-0009) and from the odhcpd update (IPv6 RA lifetime 0, no RDNSS), plus a plaintext telemetry finding. Not release-ready.

clusters.title: mesh-agent delays DHCP at boot (same component as the OOM)
clusters.root_cause: At boot mesh-agent waits 5 s for a backhaul scan before dnsmasq serves leases, so the first DHCPACK comes 6.8 s after LAN up (1.5 s on 2.0.4). mesh-agent is new in 2.1.0 and also leaks memory until it is OOM-killed (TC-END-004).
clusters.recommendation: Add to the mesh-agent ticket: do not block boot on the backhaul scan.

clusters.title: odhcpd 2026.03.1 defaults disable the default route and RDNSS
clusters.root_cause: The updated odhcpd sets router lifetime 0 (ra_default=0) and drops the RDNSS option (dns_service=0), so IPv6 clients get no default route and no DNS server.
clusters.recommendation: Ticket to the platform team: restore ra_default=1 and dns_service=1 in the 2.1.0 defaults.

clusters.title: Telemetry sends device data over plaintext HTTP
clusters.root_cause: The new cloud telemetry service posts to telemetry.vendor.example on port 80 without TLS shortly after boot. It is the only new endpoint between 2.0.4 and 2.1.0.
clusters.recommendation: Ticket to the cloud team: move telemetry to HTTPS and review the payload.

args.cluster_title: odhcpd 2026.03.1 defaults disable the default route and RDNSS
args.title: 2.1.0: odhcpd sends RAs with router lifetime 0 and no RDNSS
args.body_md:
## Summary
After the odhcpd 2026.03.1 update, Router Advertisements on br-lan carry router lifetime 0 and no RDNSS option, so IPv6 clients get no default route and no DNS server.

## Evidence
- ev:{{test_run:TC-IPV6-002}}/log/dut-syslog/52 (ra_lifetime overridden to 0)
- ev:{{test_run:TC-IPV6-002}}/log/dut-syslog/53 (dns option disabled)
- ev:{{test_run:TC-IPV6-002}}/pcap/capture-lan/2 (RA, router lifetime 0)

## Expected
Router lifetime 1800 s and RDNSS present, as on 2.0.4.

text: **2.1.0 is not release-ready.** There are two product-bug clusters (mesh-agent: OOM and DHCP delay; odhcpd: IPv6 RA defaults) and one security finding (plaintext telemetry). Throughput needs a clean re-run once the lab switch port is fixed. Analysis saved to {{report_id}}; ticket draft created for odhcpd.
